contentHtml:
Stuck on an old email system or flaky webmail? I move individuals and businesses across to Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 with no data loss and next to no downtime. You get faster performance, access from any device, a proper amount of mailbox storage, built-in security and spam filtering, and email that works hand in hand with Docs, Sheets, Excel and Teams. I help businesses around Stretton and Brisbane, mostly remotely.

A step-by-step migration

  • Pre-migration audit. I look over your current email setup before touching anything, so the plan fits your business size and platform.
  • The migration itself. Across to Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 or whichever you prefer, with a backup of all your email, contacts and calendars taken first.
  • Testing afterwards. I check everything works before I call it done, with staff training thrown in if you want it.
  • Kept secure. No data loss, minimal or zero downtime where possible, encrypted transfers, and the admin side handled, including DNS changes and SPF and DKIM for deliverability.

I can move you from almost anything

cPanel and webmail, a personal Gmail, Outlook desktop or Exchange, Hotmail, Yahoo or BigPond, I have moved email off all of them. If you just need a domain and matching address to begin with, see my domain and custom email service, and for ongoing help across your office there is business IT support.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
